posts.corpo: 446 inhibitors with laboratory-measured potency were pulled from the public activity database, filtered to the size and flexibility range that screening actually works in. These are the yardstick: a screening method has to rank them above look-alike molecules, or it is not measuring anything.

posts.titulo: Pose reproduction failed on this target
posts.corpo: Every non-covalent crystal ligand available for this target was docked back into its own structure. None was placed correctly as the top answer — including a ligand with zero rotatable bonds, which is the easiest case there is. Scoring the true crystal pose gives a worse number than the wrong poses: the shallow, open cleft of this protein is not something this scoring function reads well.
numeros: right pose found but ranked wrong

posts.corpo: Before trusting any number on this target, the same pipeline was run on textbook redocking cases where the right answer is already known. Sub-angstrom on both. Whatever fails later, it is not the code.

Measured inhibitors were mixed with property-matched decoys and the whole set was docked blind. The question was whether the real ones come out on top. The pass mark of 0.70 was written down before the run, not after seeing the result.

Judged against the mark set beforehand, this target does not pass. Publishing this is the whole point: a project that only shows the runs that worked is not measuring, it is advertising. Next: rerun with inert decoys, which is a fairer test, and evaluate a different target whose site is deep and enclosed rather than shallow and open.

alvo.nome_longo: Cruzain (cruzipain), the major cysteine protease of Trypanosoma cruzi
alvo.doenca_nota: Over 10,000 deaths a year in the Americas. Current therapy has poor efficacy in the chronic phase and serious side effects.
alvo.recorde_fonte: A published campaign docked nearly 4 million lead-like and fragment-like compounds against cruzain, which led to reversible carbamoyl imidazole inhibitors (PubMed 31765144).
alvo.estado_nota: Failed the enrichment threshold (AUC 0.638, cutoff 0.70) and failed pose reproduction on all 5 crystal ligands redocked, from 4 structures, judged on the best of 9 poses at 2.0 A. Shallow, open cleft typical of cysteine proteases.

validacao.veredicto: Target rejected by the criterion set before the test. Pipeline itself validated.

roadmap.nome: Fair decoys, and a second target evaluated
roadmap.base: Measured: one validation round is about 642 dockings (measured inhibitors plus property-matched decoys). This is the cost of putting all seven queued targets through the gate, whether they pass or fail.

Measured on the rented pod: 414 molecules per hour on 56 cores at $0.18/hour, which is $0.000435 per molecule. AutoDock Vina is CPU only; moving the docking to the GPU we already rent should cut this sharply, but that is not measured yet and is not assumed here.
